sentences.en: Layla was a beautiful yoga teacher with a gentle spirit.

sentences.en: A good yoga session can limber you up like nothing else.

sentences.en: Yoga is becoming more and more popular every year.
sentences.zh: 瑜伽越来越受欢迎了，每年都是如此。
